verdict.rationale: USCIS's Torch developer platform issues its own API credentials: developers register accounts, form teams, work in a sandbox, and receive production keys after passing a demo. These keys cover narrow-purpose APIs (Case Status, FOIA). Nothing in the evidence documents scoping, per-key permissions, or least-privilege controls for agent credentials. missing for 10: documented per-key scopes or permission restrictions, least-privilege or agent-specific credential issuance, key rotation and revocation controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
